title: expo-splash-screen preventAutoHideAsync() seems to have no effect
body:
# TEMPORARY SOLUTION: The bug is in 0.27.6 - downgrade to 0.27.5



### Minimal reproducible example

https://github.com/reporter/splashscreentest

### What platform(s) does this occur on?

iOS

### Where did you reproduce the issue?

in Expo Go

### Summary

Calling `SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync();` seems to have no effect on the app, the splash screen is automatically hidden.

### Steps to replicate:

`npx create-expo-app@latest splashcreentest` to deploy a fresh app

Edit `app/_layout.tsx` and comment out or delete `SplashScreen.hideAsync();`

`npx expo start`

### Expected result:

Since hideAsync() is not called, the splash screen should stay forever

### Actual result:

The splash screen auto-hides anyway

comments.body:
If you look more closely at the docs, `preventAutoHideAsync` is wired up to prevent hiding the splash screen configured in the expo app.json file: https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v53.0.0/sdk/splash-screen/#splashscreenpreventautohideasync

For those not using prebuild or using a bare workflow, the app.json file has no effect when not using CNG (continuous native generation): https://docs.expo.dev/develop/user-interface/splash-screen-and-app-icon/#not-using-prebuild

So by my understanding of the above.. you'll most likely find that preventAutoHideAsync is not going to work for you unless you're using a fully managed/CNG expo workflow. Please correct me if there's something missing in my understanding of there is indeed a way to prevent the splash screen from hiding in a bare workflow project while using expo-splash-screen. 

I'm about to try the manual setup steps (for a bare workflow project) defined here: https://github.com/expo/expo/tree/main/packages/expo-splash-screen#-installation-in-bare-react-native-projects and will report back if I have any luck getting preventAutoHideAsync to work.
